title: The Yellow Colored Flower is Actually Pale Yellow (very pale)
text:
The Yellow Colored Flower is Actually Pale Yellow (very pale). I had planned on hanging this yellow flower canvas photo in our guest bathroom which happens to be decorated in a flower theme. Unfortunately, I wound up hanging it in the hallway instead. The yellow shade of the flower is not nearly as bright yellow as the photo above shows and the picture did not look right in the bathroom because of this. I was disappointed because I had the perfect place for it but it just didn't work out.

Hanging the canvas is easy and takes seconds. Mounting hardware is included.

The photo is OK, but had I known the color was so different, I wouldn't have ordered this. My overall rating is 2.5 stars.
